text:
This composition looks like a maraging steel with 17.5 Ni, 11.5 Co, 4.15 Mo and 1.48 Ti. That puts it near a C-350 type grade, which is roughly 18Ni with 12.5 Co, 4.2 Mo and 1.6 Ti. Aged C-350 has a yield strength of about 2400 MPa. The titanium and molybdenum levels here are slightly lower than in C-350, so I scaled the figure down a little. This is an estimate from grade analogy, not a calculation.

{"yield_mpa": 2300}
